notes: Page title 'The Eggtastic Specials'. Branded 'Junktion77' ('The Foodies' Crossroads', multicolour diamond logo) top-right, NOT 'Gluttons Garage'. Design: charcoal/near-black background with dark gear/cog pattern; section headings in bright red calligraphic display font; item names golden-yellow bold serif; descriptions white condensed sans; prices golden-yellow 'NN/-'. No veg/non-veg markers printed on this page. Bottom third is food photo (rolled stuffed omelette with tomato slice on white plate, ketchup, onion, burlap, greens). No tax/service-charge text. Legibility good.
